name: TelemetrySnapshot::hud

test_list.description: An empty snapshot gives cache_hit_pct None and zeros elsewhere; no division by zero.
Requests with cached_tokens == 0 only keep cache_hit_pct None.
cache_hit_pct is floor(100 * cached / prompt) over all requests once reported.
A provider reporting more cached than prompt tokens is shown as 100, not above.
burn_tokens_per_min sums prompt+completion tokens of events with timestamps inside the 60 s window ending at publication time.
record(&Event) (no timestamp) contributes to totals but not to the burn rate.
An event slightly older than the newest one but inside the window still counts; one older than the window does not.
A burn above u32::MAX tokens/min is shown as u32::MAX.
s1_avg_us and s2_avg_us are floor(total_us / count), zero with no samples.

output_description: Cache hit %, tokens burned per minute and S1/S2 average latency for the token-weather HUD.
